## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or operational enhancement.

## 💡 Problem / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a specific operational problem or maritime workflow? (e.g., *"As a Coast Guard tactical officer, I want to..."*)

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working technically or within the UI/UX.

## 🛰️ Data & Satellite Sensors Needed
Does this require specific remote sensing feeds or APIs?
- [ ] Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR
- [ ] NASA-ISRO NISAR L+S Band
- [ ] Sentinel-2 MSI Optical
- [ ] AIS Live Stream (aisstream.io / coastal transponders)
- [ ] MetOcean Currents (CMEMS / INCOIS)
- [ ] Other

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, or academic references regarding the proposed enhancement.
